newsitem.title: USA: Pulitzer trades daily for 4 weekly papers.
newsitem.headline: Pulitzer trades daily for 4 weekly papers.

text.p: Pulitzer Publishing Co said on Tuesday that it exchanged the operating assets of the 2,500 daily circulation Record-Gazette in Banning, Calif. for the operating assets of four weekly central California newspapers.
It cited market potenial as the reason for the move.

The four weeklies are the Lemore Advance, Coalinga Record, Avenal Progress and Twin City Times and Riverdale Free Press. The weeklies have a combined total of about 25,000 paid and unpaid circulation.
Separately, Pulitzer Community Newspapers Inc of St. Louis said it signed an agreement to sell The Dalles Daily Chronicle to Eagle Newspapers Inc of Oregon. Terms were not disclosed.
When the transaction is completed next week, the Chronicle will join the Eagle group which publishes newspapers in 15 communities in Oregon, Washington and Idaho.
Pulitzer acquired the Record Gazette and The Dalles Chronicle on July 1 as part of its $214.1 million purchase of the stock of the 16-publication Scripps League Newspapers Group.
